defect.description: For non-v1 run IDs, the frozen source derives RETROSPECTIVE_ANALYSIS_FREEZE_20260809_V4.md, but the actual V4 freeze is RETROSPECTIVE_ANALYSIS_FREEZE_20260810_V4.md.

runtime_shim.scope: Reuse frozen privacy/result guards and aggregate schema; correct only the freeze filename and record the shim in provenance.

acceptance_rule: Use the shim only after every required canonical stage manifest exists; run the standard release privacy and reproducibility audits on its outputs.
